TextView.android:text: Every sighting counts. Together we find them.
Three simple steps to reunite families
Submit a missing person report with photo, age, and last seen location. It reaches the community instantly.
Anyone who spots the person can share a tip directly through the app. AI-powered face matching helps narrow down leads.
Once the person is found, the report is marked as Found and the community helper earns an achievement badge.
Save a recent photo of elderly family members on your phone.
Record clothing details and identifiable marks when filing.
The first 24 hours are critical. Report as early as possible.
Post active cases to WhatsApp and social to extend reach.
Over 90% of missing persons in India are found within the first week when the community actively participates in sharing alerts. HopeConnect makes that network available to everyone.
